title: Round 20 / inventor J: estimate-then-search (MSB oracle + self-reduction + kangaroo)
question: User idea 2026-11-03: estimate k very precisely, then binary-search. Build the strongest feasible estimator of the most significant bit (or an interval) of k from Q=kP (features from x(Q), x(Q+-jP), bits, comparisons, learned models trained across curves), measure its advantage over 1/2 with CI across sizes, and quantify what advantage the hard-core-bit self-reduction and an interval+kangaroo pipeline would need to beat rho. Does any estimator show non-vanishing advantage out of sample?
rationale: Direct user idea; tests the one oracle that would make binary search work.
success_criteria: Exact statements; reproducible evidence; honest negatives.
resource_limit: One bounded subagent; no recursion; no commits.
